facts.fact: The FY2026/27 estimates give project 12601 MoHE Computerisation, Ministry of Higher Education, a development estimate of BWP 16,000,000 from the Domestic Development Fund.
Computerisation and ICT lines across seventeen organisations total BWP 895,462,597 in the FY2026/27 estimates, against BWP 251,000,000 for the digital ministry's own ICT project.
